description: Evaluation dataset for the Investment Research Evidence Agent. Questions run against synthetic fixture filings (deterministic, offline). 'expected_items' lists filing section item keys a good retriever should select. Probes are hand-labeled claim/excerpt pairs used to score the verification agent, including a fabricated citation that must be blocked.

questions.question: What are the main risks related to cloud infrastructure and cybersecurity?
What products does the company sell and through which segments does it operate?
How did total revenue change in fiscal 2023 and which segment drove the change?
What does management say about gross margin trends and their causes?
How many full-time employees does the company have?
What drove revenue growth in the quarter according to management?
What new or updated risk factors are disclosed this quarter?
What was the operating cash flow during the quarter?
Which end markets does the company serve and which is largest?
What supply chain and foundry concentration risks does the company disclose?
How did net revenue change in fiscal 2023 and which end market grew?
What material changes in risk factors occurred since the annual report?

verification_probes.claim: The filing states that revenue reached $999 billion in fiscal 2023.
verification_probes.excerpt: Total net revenue reached $999 billion in fiscal 2023.
verification_probes.note: Fabricated quote: the excerpt does not exist in the filing and must fail the citation check.

verification_probes.claim: The filing states that total net revenue increased 14% to $612.4 million in fiscal 2023.
verification_probes.excerpt: Total net revenue increased 14% to $612.4 million in fiscal 2023, compared to $537.2 million in fiscal 2022, driven primarily by a 19% increase in Subscription segment revenue.

verification_probes.claim: The filing states that revenue grew because of acquisitions in Asia and favorable currency movements across all markets.
verification_probes.excerpt: Total net revenue increased 14% to $612.4 million in fiscal 2023, compared to $537.2 million in fiscal 2022, driven primarily by a 19% increase in Subscription segment revenue.

verification_probes.claim: The filing states that gross margin increased during fiscal 2023.
verification_probes.excerpt: Gross margin declined to 58.2% from 60.1%, reflecting higher foundry wafer costs and lower factory utilization at our test facilities.
